storeCopy.seoDescription: Get Google autocomplete phrases for seed queries. Batch keywords, choose a language, and export long-tail search ideas for content and SEO research.
storeCopy.intro: Collect Google autocomplete phrases for seed queries and save one row for each suggestion. Add multiple searches and choose a language to compare related wording.
useCases: SEO specialists can find long-tail phrases related to target keywords.
Writers can discover follow-up questions and wording for article briefs.
Product marketers can compare search phrasing across topics and languages.
howToUse: Add each seed phrase to `queries` as a separate item.
Choose a two-letter language code with `hl` when needed.
Set `limit` and `maxResults` to bound suggestions and saved rows.

faqs.question: How many suggestions can one query return?
faqs.answer: Set `limit` from 1 to 10. The source may return fewer suggestions for some phrases.
